classification.difficultyReason: The source labels this group Mastery. Its parts combine algebraic perimeter, an exact area requiring Pythagoras, a perimeter equation and equal-perimeter reasoning.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Write an expression for the perimeter.

spec.description: Upright unshaded triangle with a horizontal base, one equality tick on each side and algebraic side labels outside the figure.
spec.mathematics: Left side 3x+2; right side 5x-4; base 20-3x. Preserve all three equal-side marks.
spec.answerVisibility: All side expressions and equality ticks are permanent givens. No perimeter answer appears in the question diagram.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Calculate the exact area of the triangle.

spec.description: Upright equilateral triangle with a horizontal base, matching equality ticks and 10 cm outside the left side.
spec.mathematics: All three sides are equal and therefore each is 10 cm. The question figure contains no altitude.
spec.answerVisibility: The 10 cm label and equality ticks are visible givens. Height and area are answer-only.

answer.worked:
The perpendicular height bisects the equilateral triangle’s base.
$$\begin{align*}h^2&=10^2-5^2\\h&=\sqrt{75}=5\sqrt{3}\text{ cm}\\A&=\frac{bh}{2}\\A&=\frac{10\times5\sqrt{3}}{2}\\A&=25\sqrt{3}\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Complete solution figure adding the perpendicular height, a right-angle square and two 5 cm half-base labels.
spec.mathematics: The altitude of an equilateral triangle bisects its 10 cm base. Pythagoras gives h²=10²−5².
spec.answerVisibility: This authored construction appears only with the solution.

children.label: c
children.prompt: If the perimeter is $21\text{ m}$, what is the value of $x$?

spec.description: Upright equilateral triangle with a horizontal base, one matching equality tick on each side and 2x−10 below the base.
spec.mathematics: The three equal sides each have numerical length 2x−10 in the perimeter’s metre units. The source figure prints no unit suffix.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the expression and equality marks appear in the unsolved figure.

children.label: d
children.prompt: A square has the same perimeter as the triangle. Find the area of the square.

spec.description: Upright equilateral triangle with a horizontal base, matching equality ticks and 10 cm outside the right side. No square is supplied.
spec.mathematics: Each triangle side is 10 cm, so the square shares its 30 cm perimeter.
spec.answerVisibility: The triangle’s 10 cm side and equality marks are givens. The square’s perimeter, side length and area appear only in answers.

answer.worked:
Let $s$ be the square’s side length.
$$\begin{align*}P_{\text{square}}&=3\times10=30\text{ cm}\\s&=\frac{30}{4}=7.5\text{ cm}\\A_{\text{square}}&=7.5^2\\A_{\text{square}}&=56.25\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
